reviews.reason: Related capabilities have been searched. root-planting-trial places and reserves a root but explicitly excludes cultivation and harvest; probe supplies individual observations, not a persistent cultivation assessment or safe access to the planted specimen. Develop a bounded assessment and inspection precursor, reusing those implementations. Propagation, edible yield and a beneficial tending treatment remain conditional on an actual supported physical mechanism, not on the root's name or the passage of time.
reviews.experienceReview: Study, requests, registration and merely waiting earn no experience benefit. Reuse existing probe feedback rather than adding a second cultivation reward path. Personally applicable, genuinely verified new evidence, including informative failure, may qualify once per actor and underlying fact/state transition; repeated observations of the same state do not. If the existing feedback implementation lacks an explicit bounded amount, cap, decay and cooldown, this precursor grants no additional pleasure or satisfaction until those rules are implemented. Familiar legitimate practice may qualify only through an existing bounded practice rule, never through automatic farming of inspection calls. Do not change protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions; physical comfort remains capped at 10 and nutrition is independent of mood. Findings are not automatically communicated to others: other participants must observe or communicate and act independently.
reviews.visualReview: Retain the plot's existing reusable plant component and position. Add reusable metadata for trial ID, work ID, last observed tick, observation event references, remaining work, covered/exposed state, and uncertainty label. Separate actual visible evidence from internal simulation bookkeeping: show unverified, inspection-in-progress, interrupted, covered or exposed only when those events occur. Sprout, decay, maturity or harvest visuals require corresponding physical events and visible evidence; observation checkpoints, learning and completed inspection cannot display cultivation success. Failure emits a reason-coded event and preserves the truthful plot state. Do not reveal latent viability, hidden resources or unobserved biomass through visual metadata.
reviews.specification: Current-conversation development handoff: implement a persistent planted-root assessment with modes begin, observe, inspect, resume and cancel. Record reuse of root-planting-trial's reservation/progress/ageing code and open.probe's observation/evidence code; do not claim their reinvention. Target exactly root-trial-10-moss-48 at (19.1,13.5), whose reserved input is item-10-moss-47 from start-1-roots. Resolve and validate the full live plot record during implementation/execution; the applicant's separate item-3-moss-12 is not an input. Require personal study, a living actor, actual interaction reach, an existing accessible plot, and exclusive work locking without transferring ownership or granting permissions. Beginning costs one simulation round and 0.2 energy, consumes no material and records a baseline of externally observable state; registration itself earns nothing. Keep the original plantedAt=11, elapsed time, remainingRootUnits and existing ageing, rather than restarting freshness. Use one active assessment per plot with shared physical state but actor-specific observations. Subsequent observe delegates to probe: one round and 0.2 energy, no destructive sample and no invented viability reading. Compare timestamped observable changes, including sprouts, exposed decay or moisture measurements actually supported by the engine; unchanged or inaccessible internal state stays unverified. The existing 30-elapsed-round interval is an observation checkpoint, not growth time, maturity or proof of death. Inspection is an optional two-work-round operation costing one energy per completed work round: gently uncover the existing reserved specimen and replace the displaced soil, recording only features physically exposed. Validate that the local soil can actually be worked by hand before charging or starting; otherwise emit a bounded failure and leave the specimen reserved. Track displaced soil and any actual specimen damage; inspecting cannot refresh food, heal the root or create biomass. Interruptions preserve completed work and exposed/covered state; resume charges only outstanding rounds and rechecks reach and remaining prerequisites. Cancellation releases the work lock, retains all observations and the actual exposed or covered plot state, and grants no refund of time, spent energy or decayed material. Death has the same work-release behavior and does not duplicate or teleport the planted root. No automatic reburial or continuing labor occurs after interruption, cancellation or death. Ordinary environmental ageing continues during simulated time, including while unattended; development/review waiting advances no time. Global simulation pauses preserve work and ageing state. No additional tools, water, seed stock or fertilizer is supplied. At reported moisture 0.65, do not prescribe watering without an actual need and available water. In this precursor there is no scheduled tending expense or beneficial maintenance effect; monitoring and optional inspection pay their explicit costs. During handoff inspect the existing physical growth support: activate cultivation, tending or harvest only if a coherent executable mechanism exists, with its exact material sources, water/soil/energy flows, environmental limits, damage risks, elapsed growth requirement and finite output accounting specified before any such action. Otherwise implement the assessment precursor now and clearly report that cultivation feasibility remains unresolved, not permanently rejected. Never translate a timer, observation count, source capacity or the nearby mature meadow roots into planted-root yield. No harvest is enabled by this precursor: actual new edible growth must first exist under an implemented physical rule. Reserved input remains exactly accounted for as surviving original root, damaged/decayed matter or documented physical loss; it is never simultaneously inventory, source stock and planted biomass. Public outputs are persistent trial/work state, actual observation events and verified findings with uncertainty. All validation, locks, costs, progress, deduplication and state transitions execute in code, without repeated model adjudication.
